_about: Re-check rule volume, measured once (not rebuilt weekly). Figures copied from the output of scripts/research/recheck_volume.py (NVD JSON 2.0 yearly feeds of 2026-11-07, EPSS daily files 2026-06-15 to 2026-11-07, all model v2026.06.15, KEV catalog 2026.11.06) plus an NVD change-history check of the 279 crossers that now have CPE or are in KEV. Re-run on Nov 7 and reproduced. Method and caveats: docs/research/notes/open_items_recheck_volume.md. Nov 8: the rule's threshold moved to EPSS 0.05 (Will's decision after red-team round 6). The 0.05 monthly flow, with the same change-history correction, is from scripts/research/recheck_flow_corrected.py (NVD feeds of 2026-11-08, same EPSS files), which also reproduced the 0.10 windows exactly; the 0.10 flow is kept as monthly_flow_0_10 for comparison.

stock._def: NVD status Deferred (Not Scheduled), Awaiting Analysis or Received; no CPE; not in KEV

one_time_load._def: stock CVEs with EPSS >= t on 2026-11-07

monthly_flow._def: stock CVEs whose EPSS first reached 0.05 in each 30-day window, plus CVEs that crossed before getting CPE (NVD change history)

monthly_flow_0_10._def: stock CVEs whose EPSS first reached 0.10 in each 30-day window, plus CVEs that crossed before getting CPE (NVD change history)
